description: Amazon Ad Tag event requests emitted by the official browser SDK and server GTM template. Checks tag and event identity, UTF-16 event limits, normalized reporting attributes, item arrays and optional consent JSON. Producer checks remain advisory. The loader has a separate contract. This profile does not describe the Amazon Ads Conversions API.

params.name: pid
params.description: The producer sends its configured tag identity. The browser SDK accepts UUIDs; the server template leaves identity grammar open.

params.name: event
params.description: The event name is open and limited to 256 UTF-16 code units by both pinned producers.

params.name: eventSource
params.description: The browser SDK marks its requests with amzn.js. Other producers remain open.

params.name: items
params.description: Array-style event attributes are serialized as JSON.

params.name: amazonConsentString
params.description: The producer serializes the optional consent object as JSON.

params.name: reporting_attributes
params.description: Both producers normalize these reserved reporting attributes to ASCII letters, digits and underscores.

params.name: clientDedupeId
params.description: The browser SDK retains nonempty deduplication strings through 256 UTF-16 code units. Cross-event uniqueness is external.

params.name: eventId
params.description: The browser SDK retains nonempty deduplication strings through 256 UTF-16 code units. Cross-event uniqueness is external.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The browser generates a per-request UUID when crypto.randomUUID is available.

params.name: ts
params.description: The SDK stamps browser events with epoch milliseconds.

rules.message: The browser SDK expects its configured tag identity to be a UUID.
